name: QUT Guild Student Advocacy
summary: Free, independent help with academic issues, university policies and misconduct matters for QUT students.
who: All QUT students with academic or university-related issues.
how: Book an appointment with an Advocacy Officer on the Guild website, ideally before any misconduct meeting.

evidence.quote: Student Advocacy is a free student support service.
available to all QUT students experiencing academic or university-related issues.
